decisions.reason: The cleaning centrifuge extends the firm's core filtration and coolant-management knowledge, so its in-house R&D can interpret field results and refine the product rather than abandon it.

The nozzle line complements the coolant systems; with the pressure booster withdrawn it should be watched, but it rests on established fluid-handling expertise and serves existing metalworking customers.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits at the heart of the firm's conveying competence, so performance signals are easy to read and act on.
The magnetic belt conveyor draws on deep chip-conveying know-how and a stable customer segment, which lets the firm absorb feedback and keep improving it.
The hinged belt conveyor is a core product type closely tied to existing engineering, production and service capabilities.
